VG035.message: Delivery type not defined for order type
VG035.cause: The delivery type in the sales order is not properly configured for the selected order type in SPRO.
VG035.resolution:
1. Go to SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Shipping > Deliveries > Define Delivery Types
2. Check that the delivery type is assigned to the order type
3. Verify the item category determination in VOV4

M7021.cause: The posting date field is empty in the goods movement transaction (MIGO).
M7021.resolution:
1. Enter a valid posting date in the header area
2. Ensure the posting date falls within an open fiscal period
3. Check FM period lock via transaction OB52

F5003.message: Account not found in chart of accounts
F5003.cause: The GL account number entered does not exist in the assigned chart of accounts.
F5003.resolution:
1. Verify the GL account number via FS00
2. Check the correct chart of accounts is assigned to the company code
3. Create the account if it doesn't exist using FS00 or via mass upload

VK011.cause: A pricing condition record with the same key combination already exists in the condition table.
VK011.resolution:
1. Go to VK12 to display existing condition records
2. Check the validity dates — they may overlap
3. Either modify the existing record or change the validity period of the new one

ME045.message: Authorization check failed for purchase order
ME045.cause: The user does not have the required authorization object (M_BEST_BSA or M_BEST_EKG) for the purchase order type or purchasing group.
ME045.resolution:
1. Check user authorizations via SU53 immediately after the error
2. Request the BASIS team to add the missing authorization object
3. Verify the purchasing group assignment in the user master (SU01)

KI235.message: Cost center does not exist for the period
KI235.cause: The cost center is either not created or not valid for the posting period.
KI235.resolution:
1. Check cost center master data in KS03
2. Verify the validity dates of the cost center
3. Extend the validity period if necessary using KS02

BM001.message: Material does not exist or is not active
BM001.cause: The material number entered is not found in the material master or is flagged for deletion.
BM001.resolution:
1. Check material master in MM03
2. Verify the material exists in the correct plant
3. Check if the material is flagged for deletion (deletion flag in MM02)

V1321.message: Pricing error: Condition record not found
V1321.cause: The pricing procedure could not find a valid condition record for the material/customer combination.
V1321.resolution:
1. Check pricing conditions in VK13
2. Verify the condition type is included in the pricing procedure
3. Check customer/material info records and condition exclusion groups

VL244.cause: The system could not automatically determine a batch for the delivery item. Batch determination rules are missing, no stock exists for available batches, or the batch search strategy is not configured for the plant/delivery type combination.
VL244.resolution:
1. Check batch stock in MB52 for the material/plant
2. Verify batch determination config in SPRO > Logistics Execution > Shipping > Picking
3. Check condition records in VCH1 for the batch search strategy
4. Manual workaround: enter batch directly in VL02N at item level
5. If config missing, escalate for transport

ME390.message: Release strategy could not be determined
ME390.cause: No release strategy matches the purchase order's characteristics (purchasing org, plant, material group, PO value). Either the release strategy conditions don't cover this combination, or classification is misconfigured.
ME390.resolution:
1. Check release strategy customizing in SPRO > MM > Purchasing > PO > Release Procedure
2. Verify classification conditions in CL02 (class type 032)
3. Ensure characteristics match the PO values
4. Check release codes and groups in OME1/OME2
5. Emergency release via ME28 if business-critical

ME038.cause: The purchase order requires additional release codes before it can be processed. One or more approvers have not yet released the PO.
ME038.resolution:
1. Check pending release codes in ME23N > Release Strategy tab
2. Verify approver has auth object M_EINK_FRG
3. Check approver's workflow inbox (SBWP)
4. Use SWIA for work item analysis

F5091.message: Posting only possible in periods XXXX
F5091.cause: The posting date falls in a fiscal period that is not open for the account type being posted.
F5091.resolution:
1. Check open periods in OB52
2. Open the required period for the relevant account type
3. For MM postings, also check MMPV
4. Verify user has authorization for special periods (F_BKPF_BUP)

SU_USER_LOCKED.cause: User account is locked due to too many failed login attempts or administrator lock.
SU_USER_LOCKED.resolution:
1. Verify caller identity per security protocol
2. Check lock status in SU01
3. Unlock via SU01 Lock/Unlock button
4. Reset password if expired
5. Check SM20 audit log for failed login attempts

FF805.message: Tax code does not exist in procedure
FF805.cause: The tax code entered on the financial document is not defined in the tax procedure assigned to the country key. Either the tax code was never created or the wrong country/tax procedure is assigned.
FF805.resolution:
1. Verify tax code in FTXP for the correct country key
2. Check tax procedure assignment in OBBG
3. Check GL account field status — tax field must not be suppressed
4. Verify condition records for tax code in FQ65
5. For tax jurisdiction codes (US), check OBCP

FF713.message: Tax code not permitted for this account
FF713.cause: The GL account's field status group does not allow the tax code field. The field is set to 'suppressed' in the field status variant.
FF713.resolution:
1. Check GL account field status group in FS00 > Control tab
2. Modify field status in OBC4 — change tax field to 'optional' or 'required'
3. Verify field status variant assignment to company code in OBY6

F5212.message: Reversal not possible for this document
F5212.cause: The FI document cannot be reversed because it is already cleared, the reversal period is closed, or the document type restrictions prevent reversal.
F5212.resolution:
1. If document is cleared: Reset clearing first using FBRA
2. If period is closed: Open the period in OB52 or use reversal date in current period
3. Verify reversal reasons in OBR3
4. For cleared payment documents, reset clearing before reversal

F5171.message: Amounts do not balance to zero
F5171.cause: The selected open items for clearing do not net to zero. Total debits and credits in the clearing selection are not equal.
F5171.resolution:
1. Review selected items — debits must equal credits
2. Use partial payment or residual item posting for differences
3. Check tolerance groups in OBA4 (GL), OBA3 (customer/vendor)
4. For foreign currency: Check exchange rate differences

F5343.message: No open items found for clearing
F5343.cause: The clearing selection criteria do not match any open items. Items may already be cleared, or the account/company code/date range is incorrect.
F5343.resolution:
1. Verify account number and company code
2. Check if items are already cleared in FBL1N/FBL5N (select 'All Items')
3. Widen the posting date range
4. Check for special GL indicators on the items

KO150.message: Settlement rule does not exist for order
KO150.cause: The internal order does not have a settlement rule defined. Settlement in KO88 requires a valid settlement rule specifying the receiver (cost center, asset, GL account, etc.).
KO150.resolution:
1. Open the order in KO02 > Settlement Rule tab
2. Create settlement rule with receiver type, receiver number, and percentage
3. Verify settlement profile matches the order type config in OKO7
4. Check settlement cost element in OKB9
5. Ensure receiver (cost center/asset) is valid for the period

KO154.cause: The settlement rule exists but is missing required data — settlement percentages don't sum to 100%, receiver is invalid, or validity period doesn't cover the settlement period.
KO154.resolution:
1. Check settlement rule in KO02 — percentages must total 100%
2. Verify receiver validity for the settlement period
3. Check settlement profile assignment
4. Ensure settlement cost element exists

KI270.message: Cost element does not exist in controlling area
KI270.cause: The GL account used for posting does not have a corresponding primary cost element in the controlling area. FI postings to P&L accounts require a matching cost element in CO.
KI270.resolution:
1. Check cost element existence in KA03
2. Create primary cost element in KA01 with correct category (1=Primary costs)
3. Verify GL account has 'Cost Element' checkbox in FS00
4. For automatic creation, configure OKB2
5. Ensure controlling area is correct

KI246.message: Cost element category not valid for this posting
KI246.cause: The cost element exists but has the wrong category for the type of posting. For example, a secondary cost element (category 41/42) cannot receive direct postings from FI.
KI246.resolution:
1. Check cost element category in KA03
2. Category 1 (primary) is needed for FI postings
3. Categories 41/42 (assessment/distribution) cannot receive direct postings
4. Create a new cost element with correct category if needed
5. Check if category can be changed in KA02 (only if no postings exist)

CO083.message: Missing parts exist for the operation
CO083.cause: Production order confirmation cannot proceed because components required for the operation are not available. Stock is insufficient or components are missing from the BOM.
CO083.resolution:
1. Check component list in CO03 > Components tab
2. Verify stock availability in MB52/MMBE
3. Post goods receipt for pending components in MIGO
4. Check COGI for stuck backflush entries
5. For partial confirmation, reduce yield quantity to match available components

MD045.cause: MRP run completed but generated exception messages indicating potential issues — such as rescheduling recommendations, past-due orders, or capacity overloads.
MD045.resolution:
1. Review MRP results in MD04 (Stock/Requirements List)
2. Check exception messages and their meaning
3. Verify MRP parameters in material master (MRP 1/2/3 views)
4. Check lot sizing procedure and lead times
5. Use MD07 for planned order overview and conversion

CK373.message: BOM could not be exploded for production order
CK373.cause: The system cannot find or explode a valid Bill of Material for the material/plant/date combination specified in the production order.
CK373.resolution:
1. Check BOM existence in CS03 (usage 1 = Production)
2. Verify BOM validity dates cover the order start date
3. Check BOM status — must be Active (status 1)
4. Verify component materials exist in the plant
5. Check for recursive BOMs
6. For configurable materials, check CU41

CK002.cause: No Bill of Material exists for the specified material in the given plant with the required BOM usage.
CK002.resolution:
1. Verify material and plant in CS03
2. Check BOM usage — production requires usage 1
3. Create BOM in CS01 if missing
4. Check alternative BOM selection criteria
5. Verify material type allows BOM creation

CO502.message: Status of order does not allow this function
CO502.cause: The requested operation (release, confirmation, technical completion) is not permitted in the current production order status. The order may be missing required data or has a blocking status.
CO502.resolution:
1. Check order status in CO03 > Status tab
2. For release issues: Verify routing and BOM are assigned
3. For TECO: Check pending confirmations and goods movements
4. Check COGI for stuck goods movements
5. Use COHV for mass status changes if needed

STMS_RC12.message: Transport import failed with return code 12
STMS_RC12.cause: Transport import failed with critical errors. Objects could not be imported due to conflicts, missing prerequisites, or syntax errors in transported programs.
STMS_RC12.resolution:
1. Check transport log in STMS > Import Overview > Logs
2. For 'object locked by another transport': Release the blocking transport
3. For 'syntax error': Import prerequisite transports first
4. For 'table entry exists': Use overwrite flag or delete conflicting entries
5. Reimport with appropriate options in STMS
6. Check tp log at OS level for detailed errors

RFC_COMM_FAILURE.message: RFC communication failure — destination not reachable
RFC_COMM_FAILURE.cause: The RFC destination configured in SM59 cannot reach the target system. Causes include network issues, wrong host/port, target system down, or firewall blocking the connection.
RFC_COMM_FAILURE.resolution:
1. Test connection in SM59 (Ctrl+F2)
2. Verify host, IP address, and port
3. Check network connectivity and firewall rules
4. Verify target system is running
5. For logon failures: Check RFC user credentials and lock status
6. Check SMGW for stuck connections

M7036.message: Stock is insufficient for the withdrawal
M7036.cause: The material does not have enough unrestricted-use stock in the specified plant and storage location to fulfill the goods issue quantity.
M7036.resolution:
1. Check stock in MB52/MMBE
2. Check if stock exists in a different storage location
3. Verify no reservations are blocking the stock (MB21/MB22)
4. For batch-managed materials, check specific batch quantities
5. Check if negative stock is allowed in OMJ1

M7032.cause: The goods issue would result in negative stock, which is not permitted for this plant/valuation area. The negative stock configuration is disabled.
M7032.resolution:
1. Check stock levels in MB52
2. Verify negative stock settings in OMJ1
3. Post goods receipt first if material has arrived
4. Transfer stock from another storage location if available
5. Enabling negative stock is NOT recommended for production environments

M7115.message: Material document has already been reversed
M7115.cause: The material document selected for reversal has already been cancelled. A reversal document already exists referencing this original document.
M7115.resolution:
1. Check original document in MB03 for existing reversal reference
2. Verify in MB51 — look for movement type 102 referencing the document
3. No action needed if already reversed
4. If duplicate reversal was intended, investigate the business scenario

M7562.message: Reversal not possible — subsequent document exists
M7562.cause: The material document cannot be reversed because follow-on documents depend on it — such as invoice verification (MIRO), quality inspection lots, or transfer postings.
M7562.resolution:
1. Check follow-on documents in MB03 > Environment > Follow-on Documents
2. Reverse dependent documents first: MIRO invoice (MR8M), transfer postings
3. Cancel quality inspection lots in QA02 if applicable
4. Check PO history in ME23N for all linked documents
5. Reverse in correct sequence: invoice > transfer > GR

VF045.message: Billing document could not be created
VF045.cause: Billing document creation failed due to missing data in the delivery or sales order. Incompletion log errors indicate required fields are not maintained.
VF045.resolution:
1. Check billing due list in VF04 for error details
2. Run incompletion analysis — V.00 or check log in VF01
3. Maintain missing data: payment terms, tax classification, pricing
4. Check and remove billing blocks in VL02N/VA02
5. Verify copy control in VTFL/VTFA
6. Check revenue account determination in VKOA

VL461.message: Shipping point could not be determined
VL461.cause: The system cannot determine a shipping point for the delivery based on the combination of shipping condition (customer master), loading group (material master), and plant (sales order).
VL461.resolution:
1. Check shipping condition, loading group, and plant in the sales order (VA03)
2. Verify shipping point determination in SPRO
3. Add missing combination in customizing if needed
4. Or correct source data: customer shipping condition (XD02), material loading group (MM02)
5. Check route determination as well

VL248.message: No delivery could be generated for the sales order
VL248.cause: Delivery creation failed because shipping point determination failed, requested delivery date is in the past, or the sales order items have delivery blocks.
VL248.resolution:
1. Check shipping point determination (see VL461)
2. Verify requested delivery date in the sales order
3. Check for delivery blocks at order or item level in VA03
4. Verify ATP (availability check) results
5. Use VL10A/VL10B for collective delivery creation with error analysis

ME062.message: Account assignment mandatory but not complete
ME062.cause: The purchase order item requires account assignment (cost center, internal order, WBS element, or asset) but the mandatory fields are not filled. This applies to non-stock items with account assignment category K, F, P, or A.
ME062.resolution:
1. Check account assignment category in ME21N item details
2. Enter cost center (K), production order (F), WBS element (P), or asset (A)
3. Maintain the GL account for consumable purchases
4. For stock items, account assignment is automatic via OBYC
5. Check default values in ME21N > Account Assignment tab

F110_SKIP.message: Vendor not selected in automatic payment run
F110_SKIP.cause: The automatic payment program F110 skipped certain vendor invoices. Common reasons include payment block on line items, missing payment method in vendor master, invoices not yet due, or missing bank details.
F110_SKIP.resolution:
1. Check F110 proposal log for skip reasons
2. Remove payment blocks on line items in FB02
3. Maintain payment method in vendor master (XK02)
4. Verify due dates and extend 'Next payment date' if needed
5. Maintain vendor bank details in XK02
6. Check FBZP configuration for payment methods and bank determination

KM731.message: No sender values found in assessment/distribution cycle
KM731.cause: The assessment or distribution cycle found no actual costs on the sender cost centers for the specified period and cost element group.
KM731.resolution:
1. Check sender cost center postings in KSB1
2. Verify cost element group includes elements with postings
3. Confirm correct fiscal year and period
4. Check cycle definition in KSU2/KSV2
5. Run test first with 'Test Run' checkbox

KM701.cause: The cycle configuration has mismatched senders and receivers. Receiver tracing factors do not total correctly, or circular references exist between senders and receivers.
KM701.resolution:
1. Check receiver tracing factors in cycle segments
2. Verify receiver cost centers are valid for the period
3. Check for circular references (sender = receiver)
4. Assessment needs category 42 cost element; distribution uses originals
5. Run in test mode first

PERF_DEGRADE.cause: SAP system is experiencing slow response times. Multiple work processes are in running state with high runtimes. Causes include expensive SQL, lock contention, insufficient memory, or buffer overflows.
PERF_DEGRADE.resolution:
1. Check work processes in SM50/SM66
2. Review system performance in ST03
3. Check memory and buffers in ST02
4. Analyze database performance in ST04
5. For specific long-running processes, use ST12 trace
6. Check table buffering in ST10

AUTH_MISMATCH.message: User authorization mismatch after role change
AUTH_MISMATCH.cause: Role modifications in PFCG are not reflected for assigned users. The role was changed but user comparison was not performed, so users still have the old authorization profile.
AUTH_MISMATCH.resolution:
1. Regenerate the role in PFCG > Authorizations tab > Generate
2. Run user comparison in PFCG > User tab > User Comparison
3. Or run PFUD for mass user master comparison
4. Check composite roles — regenerate those too
5. Verify with SU53 after changes

VA01.name: Create Sales Order
VA01.description: Create a new sales order. Enter order type, sales org, distribution channel, and division in the initial screen.

VA02.name: Change Sales Order
VA02.description: Modify an existing sales order. Enter the order number to make changes.

VA03.name: Display Sales Order
VA03.description: View a sales order in display mode (read-only).

ME21N.name: Create Purchase Order
ME21N.description: Create a new purchase order with the enjoy transaction. Supports direct PO creation and conversion from purchase requisitions.

ME23N.name: Display Purchase Order
ME23N.description: View a purchase order in display mode.

MIGO.name: Goods Movement
MIGO.description: Post goods movements including goods receipt, goods issue, transfer posting, and stock transfer.

MIRO.name: Invoice Verification
MIRO.description: Enter and verify vendor invoices against purchase orders and goods receipts.

FB60.name: Enter Vendor Invoice
FB60.description: Post vendor invoices directly in Financial Accounting (without MM integration).

FB01.name: Post Document
FB01.description: Create general FI posting documents including journal entries.

MM01.name: Create Material Master
MM01.description: Create a new material master record with all organizational views (basic data, purchasing, MRP, accounting, etc.).

XK01.name: Create Vendor Master (Centrally)
XK01.description: Create a vendor master record with both general data and company code data.

SU01.name: User Maintenance
SU01.description: Create, change, and display user master records. Assign roles, profiles, and set passwords.

SM37.name: Job Overview
SM37.description: Monitor and manage background jobs. View job status, logs, and scheduling details.

VL01N.name: Create Outbound Delivery
VL01N.description: Create an outbound delivery with reference to a sales order.

VF01.name: Create Billing Document
VF01.description: Create billing documents (invoices) with reference to deliveries or sales orders.

CO01.name: Create Production Order
CO01.description: Create a production order manually. Enter material, plant, and order type.

SE38.name: ABAP Editor
SE38.description: Create, modify, and execute ABAP programs and reports.

SPRO.name: Customizing
SPRO.description: SAP Implementation Guide (IMG). Entry point for all configuration and customization activities.

VL02N.name: Change Outbound Delivery
VL02N.description: Change an existing outbound delivery. Used for picking confirmation, packing, and Post Goods Issue (PGI). Enter delivery number to modify.

VL03N.name: Display Outbound Delivery
VL03N.description: Display an outbound delivery in read-only mode. Check delivery status, PGI status, and item details.

VL06G.name: List of Outbound Deliveries for Goods Issue
VL06G.description: Display list of deliveries ready for goods issue. Filter by shipping point, delivery date, and status. Used for mass PGI processing.

MB52.name: List of Warehouse Stocks on Hand
MB52.description: Display stock overview per material, plant, and storage location. Shows unrestricted, quality inspection, and blocked stock including batch details.

MB51.name: Material Document List
MB51.description: Display material document list filtered by material, plant, movement type, posting date. Essential for tracking goods movements history.

ME28.name: Release Purchase Order
ME28.description: Release (approve) purchase orders. Select POs by release group, release code, purchasing group, or PO number. Supports collective and individual release.

SU53.name: Authorization Check Display
SU53.description: Display the last failed authorization check for a user. Must be run IMMEDIATELY after the authorization error occurs. Shows the missing authorization object, field, and required values.

SM12.name: Display and Delete Locks
SM12.description: Display all enqueue lock entries in the system. Used to find and delete stale locks that block other users from processing documents.

SM20.name: Security Audit Log
SM20.description: Analyze the security audit log. Shows login attempts, transaction starts, RFC calls, and other security-relevant events.

WE02.name: Display IDOC
WE02.description: Display individual IDOC with full details including control record, data records, and status records. Filter by IDOC number, message type, partner.

WE05.name: IDOC Lists
WE05.description: Display IDOC overview list with filtering by date, status, direction, message type. Quick view of IDOC processing status across the system.

BD87.name: Reprocess IDOCs
BD87.description: Manually reprocess failed IDOCs (status 51, 56, 61, etc.). Select by IDOC number or date range and resubmit for processing.

OB52.name: Open/Close Posting Periods
OB52.description: Maintain posting period variants. Open and close fiscal periods for different account types (Assets, Customers, Vendors, GL, Materials).

MMPV.name: Close Period for Material Management
MMPV.description: Open or close posting periods specifically for Materials Management. MM periods are separate from FI posting periods.

VCH1.name: Create Batch Search Strategy (Condition Records)
VCH1.description: Maintain condition records for batch determination search strategy. Defines which batches to select based on classification characteristics.

MMRV.name: Allow Posting to Previous Period
MMRV.description: Toggle whether postings are allowed to the previous MM period. Used during month-end close to allow late postings.

PFCG.name: Role Maintenance
PFCG.description: Create, change, and maintain authorization roles. Define menu structure and generate authorization profiles for user access control.

FB08.name: Reverse Document
FB08.description: Reverse a posted FI document. Enter document number, company code, fiscal year, and reversal reason. Creates a new reversal document.

FBRA.name: Reset Cleared Items
FBRA.description: Reset (undo) the clearing of FI documents. Must be executed before reversing a cleared document. Enter the clearing document number.

F-03.name: Clear GL Account
F-03.description: Clear open items on a GL account. Select open items that net to zero and post the clearing document.

F-32.name: Clear Customer Open Items
F-32.description: Clear open items on a customer account. Used for incoming payment clearing and credit memo clearing.

F-44.name: Clear Vendor Open Items
F-44.description: Clear open items on a vendor account. Used for outgoing payment clearing and credit memo clearing.

F110.name: Automatic Payment Program
F110.description: Run automatic payment processing for vendors and customers. Includes proposal creation, payment execution, and printout steps.

FTXP.name: Maintain Tax Codes
FTXP.description: Create and maintain tax codes for a country. Define tax rates and account determination for input/output tax.

FS00.name: GL Account Master (Central)
FS00.description: Create, change, and display GL account master data centrally. Maintain chart of accounts and company code level data.

KS01.name: Create Cost Center
KS01.description: Create a new cost center master record. Enter controlling area, cost center number, validity period, and hierarchy assignment.

KS02.name: Change Cost Center
KS02.description: Modify an existing cost center master record. Change description, responsible person, validity dates, or hierarchy assignment.

KS03.name: Display Cost Center
KS03.description: Display a cost center master record in read-only mode. Check validity dates, hierarchy assignment, and master data.

KO01.name: Create Internal Order
KO01.description: Create a new internal order. Enter order type, controlling area, and order details including settlement rule.

KO02.name: Change Internal Order
KO02.description: Modify an existing internal order. Change master data, settlement rules, status, or budget.

KO88.name: Settle Internal Order
KO88.description: Settle costs from an internal order to receivers (cost centers, assets, GL accounts). Requires a valid settlement rule.

KA01.name: Create Cost Element
KA01.description: Create a primary or secondary cost element. Select correct category: 1=Primary costs, 11=Revenue, 41=Overhead assessment, 42=Overhead distribution.

KA03.name: Display Cost Element
KA03.description: Display a cost element master record. Check category, controlling area, validity period, and attributes.

KSB1.name: Cost Center Actual Line Items
KSB1.description: Display actual cost line items posted to cost centers. Filter by cost center, cost element, posting date, and fiscal period.

KSU5.name: Execute Assessment Cycle
KSU5.description: Execute a CO assessment cycle to allocate overhead costs from sender to receiver cost centers using secondary cost elements.

KSV5.name: Execute Distribution Cycle
KSV5.description: Execute a CO distribution cycle to allocate costs from sender to receiver cost centers using original (primary) cost elements.

CO02.name: Change Production Order
CO02.description: Modify an existing production order. Change quantities, dates, components, operations, or status.

CO03.name: Display Production Order
CO03.description: Display a production order in read-only mode. View header, operations, components, status, costs, and confirmations.

CO11N.name: Confirm Production Order (Time Ticket)
CO11N.description: Enter time ticket confirmation for a production order operation. Record yield, scrap, activity quantities, and goods movements.

CO15.name: Confirm Production Order (Final Confirmation)
CO15.description: Enter final confirmation for a production order including automatic goods receipt of the finished product.

MD01.name: MRP Run (Total Planning)
MD01.description: Execute MRP (Material Requirements Planning) for all materials in a plant. Processing keys: NETCH (net change), NEUPL (regenerative).

MD02.name: MRP Run (Single Item)
MD02.description: Execute MRP for a single material. Used for testing MRP parameters or urgent single-material planning.

MD04.name: Stock/Requirements List
MD04.description: Display the current stock and requirements situation for a material. Shows planned orders, purchase requisitions, reservations, and available stock over time.

MD07.name: Planned Order Overview
MD07.description: Display and manage planned orders from MRP. Convert planned orders to production orders or purchase requisitions.

CS01.name: Create BOM (Bill of Material)
CS01.description: Create a new Bill of Material for a material. Enter components, quantities, and validity dates.

CS03.name: Display BOM
CS03.description: Display a Bill of Material in read-only mode. Check components, quantities, validity dates, and BOM status.

COGI.name: Post Goods Issues for Production Order (Stuck Backflush)
COGI.description: Reprocess failed automatic goods issues (backflush) from production order confirmations. Shows materials where backflush failed due to stock shortages.

COHV.name: Mass Processing for Production Orders
COHV.description: Perform mass changes on production orders. Release, schedule, confirm, or technically complete multiple orders at once.

STMS.name: Transport Management System
STMS.description: Central transport management. Import and export transport requests, configure transport routes, and monitor transport logs across the system landscape.

SE09.name: Transport Organizer (Workbench Requests)
SE09.description: Display and manage workbench transport requests. Release, display logs, and check objects in transport requests.

SM59.name: RFC Destinations (Display/Maintain)
SM59.description: Configure and test RFC (Remote Function Call) destinations. Define connection parameters for remote SAP and non-SAP systems.

SM50.name: Work Process Overview
SM50.description: Display all work processes on the current application server. Shows status, type, runtime, and current report for each process.

SM66.name: Global Work Process Overview
SM66.description: Display work processes across all application servers in the system. Used for system-wide performance monitoring.

ST22.name: ABAP Runtime Error (Dump Analysis)
ST22.description: Analyze ABAP short dumps (runtime errors). View error details, call stack, source code position, and variables at time of error.

SMGW.name: Gateway Monitor
SMGW.description: Monitor SAP gateway connections. Display active connections, logged-on clients, and RFC server registrations.

SU10.name: Mass User Maintenance
SU10.description: Perform mass changes on user master records. Lock/unlock, assign roles, change passwords, or modify user details for multiple users.

PFUD.name: User Master Comparison
PFUD.description: Perform user master comparison to synchronize role changes with assigned users. Ensures PFCG role modifications are applied to all users.

FBZP.name: Payment Program Configuration
FBZP.description: Configure the automatic payment program (F110). Define paying company codes, payment methods, bank determination, and house banks.

FBL1N.name: Vendor Line Items
FBL1N.description: Display vendor line items. Filter by open items, cleared items, or all items. Shows posting details, due dates, and payment information.

FBL5N.name: Customer Line Items
FBL5N.description: Display customer line items. Filter by open items, cleared items, or all items. Shows posting details, due dates, and dunning information.

MR8M.name: Cancel Invoice Document
MR8M.description: Cancel (reverse) an invoice document posted via MIRO. Enter the invoice document number to create a cancellation document.

VF04.name: Maintain Billing Due List
VF04.description: Display and process the billing due list. Shows deliveries and orders ready for billing with error analysis for failed billing attempts.

XD02.name: Change Customer Master (Centrally)
XD02.description: Change a customer master record with both general data and company code/sales area data.

XK02.name: Change Vendor Master (Centrally)
XK02.description: Change a vendor master record with both general data and company code data. Maintain payment methods, bank details, and purchasing data.

ME2M.name: Purchase Orders by Material
ME2M.description: Display purchase orders filtered by material number. Shows PO details, delivery status, and GR/IR status for each material.

VL10A.name: Delivery Creation for Sales Orders
VL10A.description: Collective delivery creation from sales orders. Select orders by shipping point, delivery date, and other criteria for batch delivery processing.

VKOA.name: Revenue Account Determination
VKOA.description: Configure automatic revenue account determination for billing documents. Maps chart of accounts, sales org, account assignment group, and material group to GL accounts.
